chapter_theme: Conduct that does not fit (கூடா ஒழுக்கம்): those who do wrong in secret forget that the Lord is an overseer present everywhere, and those who seek him in the north or across the land forget that he is within the body; those who see him give up their stealth. The later verses turn to grace that clears the mind, to the soul and its awareness, and to knowing oneself as the chief work.
structure_note: The Lord as overseer (கண்காணி) before whom hidden wrong is futile (2067, 2068, 2072, 2074); against seeking him outside (2070, 2071) and against sects that do not know him (2073); then a run of compressed verses on grace, the soul, awareness and the tattvas (2075 to 2083) whose tie to the title is loose.

2067.reading: Saying there is no overseer, people commit many thefts; when you look, there is no place without an overseer; those who saw the one who stands mingled everywhere as overseer have given up stealth.
2067.nuance: கண்காணி, a supervisor or watchman, opens every line. கள்ளம் and களவு cover hidden wrongdoing generally, not only theft. The cure is not fear of being caught but seeing the overseer, after which stealth simply ends.

2068.reading: He knows what was done; the men of this sea-girt world who cry out great falsehoods, if they speak truth, will be made worshipped by the gods by the one whose throat glows dark.
2068.nuance: செய்தான் அறியும் may also mean 'the doer himself knows'. The dark throat (மைதாழ்ந்து இலங்கும் மிடறு) is Siva's, from swallowing the poison.

2069.reading: Rebirth is for the drunken who pass the day selling ten and eating; for the madmen who pound the seed-grain, eat it and lay waste the field, there is never any birth.
2069.nuance: A riddle. பத்து (ten) may be the ten organs of sense and action, spent for daily living. The 'madmen' who eat the seed and ruin the field are taken as those who destroy the seed of karma, so nothing grows into a new birth; பித்தர் is also a word for Siva's devotees.

2070.reading: They say 'north, north', but nothing has been placed there; those without knowledge set out to walk; all the world contained in the north is contained within, for those who know.
2070.nuance: Going north may be pilgrimage to Kailas or the vow of facing north until death (வடக்கிருத்தல்). The verse does not say which; its point is that what is sought there lies within.

2071.reading: They wander everywhere in the land seeking Nandi, the one who stirs the body, the lord of the body's good land, who is fragrant within the body; they do not know the purpose that stands in the body.
2071.nuance: காயம் (body) recurs in every line. காயக் குழப்பன் is unclear: one who kneads or works the body, or one who stirs within it. Against the poets who scorn the body, Tirumular makes it the land where the Lord lives.

2072.reading: As overseer he rises in the hand; as overseer he stays in the mind; as overseer he mingles and makes the way; the beloved who has become overseer is he.
2072.nuance: கையகத்தே எழும் may echo the proverbial gooseberry in the palm: present and plain. The last line turns the watchman into the lover (காதலன்), so the overseer of 2067 is not a threat.

2073.reading: Virgins in one enclosure, the learned in another, those doing great tapas in another, those who have known their own nature by contemplation in another: what is this? They do not know the Lord's nature.
2073.nuance: சிறை may be an enclosure, a side or a prison: each group shut in its own discipline. கன்னி is unclear here; it may be the celibate. The verse faults division rather than any one practice.

2074.reading: In the eye that cannot see, the film is what hides the eye's light; that light is unseen too by those who do not see; those who have seen, without seeing, the great Eye that is eye even to the unseeing have given up stealth.
2074.nuance: படலம் is a cataract or film over the eye, traditionally read as mala. காணாது கண்டார், seeing without seeing, is seeing not with the eye. The last words repeat 2067's ending (களவொழிந்தாரே).

2075.reading: As a madman cleared by medicine returns to his nature, and as an eye regains its own light, so when Nandi gave grace I, clear in mind, ceased from doing.
2075.nuance: பிரகிருதி here is one's natural state. செயல் ஒழிந்தேன், I ceased from action, is the end of acting from one's own will, not idleness.

2076.reading: The eight moved as the Lord's power; not knowing them to be filled with the Supreme, people do not wake; the schemers intent on intoxication gave up thinking of the One free of ill.
2076.nuance: The eight (எட்டும்) are traditionally Siva's eight forms: the five elements, sun, moon and the soul. சுராமயம் may be 'full of liquor' or 'of the gods (sura)'. பள்ளியுணரார் may be 'they do not wake from sleep'. நிராமயம் (free of disease) is an epithet of the Lord.

2077.reading: For those who were one and two and have become one by uniting, one and two never come together; for all who keep saying 'one or two', the One that has become one with one stands as one and two.
2077.nuance: The verse plays on the debate whether soul and Lord are one or two. It seems to say those who have united no longer think in those terms, while for the debaters the truth appears as both; the Siddhanta term for this is advaita as inseparable union.

2078.reading: If the soul stands still, where will awareness stand? Without knowing, the body falls; soul and food lie together, and people do not know how the crop lies within.
2078.nuance: அயர் அறிவு may be weary or absent knowing. பயிர் (crop) may be the body that grows from food, or what grows in the soul. The verse is compressed and may be damaged.

2079.reading: When the soul is seen as distinct, awareness spreads everywhere; if one knows the soul, awareness becomes knowledge; people do not know the great Being that then swallows body and awareness.
2079.nuance: உணர்வு (awareness) and அறிவு (knowledge) are set apart. Line 3 (உயிர் அன்று உடலை விழுங்கும் உணர்வை) is hard; அன்று may be 'then' or 'not'.

2080.reading: The linchpin of the world, the bright flame, the highest Siddha, stands to be known as the linchpin of the land in the five; the chief work toward the Lord of the gods is knowing oneself.
2080.nuance: ஆணி (linchpin, nail, also the finest gold) plays through the verse: உலகாணி, நிலவாணி, சிலவாணி, தலைவாணி. Only the last line is clear: self-knowledge is the principal thing.

2081.reading: The lone flame that stands as 'He is the end', the bright flame that stands as the end of the body and as the world, standing as the fullness of sweetness: give up petty pleasure; this is the grace of the King of endless qualities.
2081.nuance: அந்தம் recurs: end, limit, and in தேன்அந்தம் perhaps 'beauty' or 'fullness'. சிற்றின்பம் (petty pleasure), usually sensual pleasure, is set against the Lord's sweetness.

2082.reading: None knows the purpose of the Lord, first in all from stone up, who says the flesh and life that are yours exist; if one stands so that the name that rose upon the good First is gone, one becomes the tattva that is one's own first.
2082.nuance: கல்முதல் and நாமம் அற நின்றால் are obscure. The drift may be that when name and identity drop away one reaches one's source; I can't fix more than that.

2083.reading: The senses and the inner organs came to the soul as the subtle body, not the gross; through the five kinds they give, the Purusha too abides in the heart at the end of the thirty-six.
2083.nuance: சூக்கும உடல் (the subtle body), அந்தக்கரணம் (inner organs) and ஆறாறு (36, the tattvas) are technical. ஐவிதம் may be the five kanchukas; the verse is a compressed tattva statement.

links.note: Both deny that hidden wrong is hidden: in the Kural the five elements within laugh at the deceiver's concealed conduct, in Tirumular the Lord stands everywhere as overseer. The Kural's witness is in the body, Tirumular's is the Lord.
2039 makes north and south the temple of the mind; 2070 says the world gathered in the north is within, against those who walk north to find it.
1729 says Nandi took the body as his temple; 2071 faults those who search the land for the one fragrant within the body.
Both end in களவொழிந்தாரே; 2067 says stealth ends when the overseer is seen, 2074 says how he is seen: not with the eye, whose film hides the light.

2068 opens 'he knows what was done' (செய்தான் அறியும்), which the nuance notes may also be 'the doer himself knows', and promises that those who speak truth will be worshipped by the gods. The Kural says not to lie about what one's own heart knows (தன்நெஞ்சு அறிவது), for the heart will burn the liar. On the second reading of செய்தான் அறியும், both ground truthfulness in the doer's own knowledge of the deed; on the first, Siva stands where the Kural puts the heart.

2069's riddle says those who pound and eat the seed-grain (வித்துக்குற்றுண்டு) and lay waste the field have no birth, read as destroying the seed of karma. The Kural names craving as the seed (வித்து) that produces unceasing birth. The Kural says what the seed is; Tirumular's madmen are those who destroy it.

2067 uses கண்காணி, the overseer, to end stealth: no place is without him, and those who see him give up theft. 2072 repeats கண்காணி in every line but ends by calling the overseer the beloved (காதலன்) who mingles and makes the way. The pair turns the watchman of 2067 from a check on wrongdoing into the lover.

2073 sees virgins, the learned, ascetics and contemplatives each in their own enclosure (ஒருசிறை) and says none knows the Lord's nature. 1530 says the six sects standing in the assembly (ஆயத்துள்) do not see the God standing in the body. Both fault division into separate camps as the cause of missing the Lord.

2075 says that when Nandi gave grace, 'I, clear in mind, ceased from doing' (செயல் ஒழிந்தேன்). 288 says that if devotees abide radiant and cease from action (செயலற்றிருந்திடில்), the Lord comes and stands among them. 288 makes actionlessness the condition for the Lord's coming; 2075 reports it as the result of his grace.

2076 says the schemers intent on சுராமயம், read as intoxication, gave up thinking of the One free of ill, and do not see the eight as filled with the Supreme. 329 says the great fools who drink deluding liquor do not discern maya or release from it. On the liquor reading of சுராமயம, both make intoxication the thing that blinds people to the Lord; on the reading 'of the gods' the link lapses.

2077 says that for those who have become one by uniting, 'one' and 'two' never come together, while for those who keep saying 'one or two' the One stands as both. 1441 reports that after reaching the state where He and I are not two, 'I can no longer speak of He and I' (சாற்றகில்லேனே). 1441 is the first-person case of 2077's claim that the united drop the one-or-two terms.

2079 says 'if one knows the soul, awareness becomes knowledge' (உயிரை அறியில் உணர்வு அறிவாகும்). 2318 says 'knowing oneself is knowledge' (தன்னை அறிவது அறிவாம்) and anything else is a ghoul's knowing. Both define real knowledge as knowledge of the self.

2080 ends that the chief work toward the Lord of the gods is knowing oneself (தலைவாணி செய்வது தன்னை அறிவதே). 2355 says knowing oneself brings no harm and, once known, one stays worshipping oneself. Both put self-knowledge at the head of worship.

2081 tells the reader to give up சிற்றின்பம், petty pleasure, for the sweetness of the Lord. The Kural says those who want the other joy do not do wrong out of desire for சிற்றின்பம். Both set the same word against a greater joy, though in the Kural the small joy is gain from coveting and in Tirumular it is sensual pleasure.

2083 says the senses and inner organs came to the soul as the subtle body (சூக்க உடல்), not the gross. 2201 counts the states by how much of the eightfold subtle body (புரியட்டகம்) is active: all in waking, three in dream, two in sleep, one in turiya. 2083 names what the subtle body is made of; 2201 uses it to define the states.

source_issues: 2078 and 2082 are compressed to the point of obscurity and may be corrupt.
The chapter title (கூடா ஒழுக்கம்) fits 2067 to 2074 only loosely and 2075 to 2083 hardly at all; the grouping of these verses may be editorial.
